method: For each input: t=(d-1)/beta; powers=t**j; Z=sum(powers); R_i=(Z+(d-1)*sum(powers[:i-1]))/sum(powers[:i]); assert Z<beta; margin=beta-max(R_i)>0.
execution_role: Four direct scalar substitutions performed during read-only preparation of round3; not a rerun of the full triangular audit programs and not a new blind review.
scope: Finite exact diagnostics of the reviewed rational upper-root formula; all-real theorem proved separately.
